final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, 3 of 3.

The cause is the vendored `slugify` 1.2.0, which drops any non-ASCII letter. Its changelog says 1.2.1 fixes this. I couldn't edit `vendor/`, so I changed `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js`. It now removes the accent marks before calling slugify.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored function and still drop accented letters. I left them alone to keep the change small. Have the platform team upgrade `vendor/slugify` to 1.2.1, which would fix both places, and the workaround in `postSlug` could then be removed.
